name: FoundryGuard community pack
description: Line rules synced by FoundryGuard Layer 17. Each rule must match its test.hit line and not its test.miss line, or the client drops it.

rules.title: Typo `=+` assigns instead of adding
rules.mitigation: `x =+ y` sets x to y. Use `x += y` when the intent is to add.

rules.title: Bidirectional control character in source (Trojan Source)
rules.mitigation: Remove Unicode bidi overrides (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069); the code the compiler sees differs from what a reviewer reads.
rules.fix: // delete the invisible U+202E / U+2066..U+2069 characters

rules.title: Deprecated Solidity built-in
rules.mitigation: Replace suicide, sha3, callcode, block.blockhash, msg.gas and throw with selfdestruct (or nothing), keccak256, delegatecall, blockhash, gasleft() and revert().

rules.title: Secret kept in a `private` state variable
rules.mitigation: `private` only hides a variable from other contracts; anyone can read the storage slot. Keep secrets off-chain or store a commitment (hash) instead.
rules.fix: bytes32 private passwordHash; // keccak256 of the secret, checked on reveal

rules.title: tarfile.extractall without a filter (path traversal)
rules.mitigation: Archive members can hold `../` paths or links. Pass `filter="data"` (Python 3.12+, backported to 3.8.17+) or check every member before extracting.
rules.fix:
with tarfile.open(path) as tar:
    tar.extractall(dest, filter="data")
